feature_notes.has_sensitive_form: A login or payment form is present; this alone is not a high-risk finding.
feature_notes.cross_origin_sensitive_form: A sensitive form sends data to a different origin.
feature_notes.form_destination_changed: A current form action differs from the user-approved local baseline.
feature_notes.new_sensitive_form: A credential or payment form appeared after the local baseline was saved.
feature_notes.deceptive_brand_domain: A brand-like hostname is not controlled by the expected brand domain.
feature_notes.punycode_or_ip_host: The host is punycode or a raw IP address.
feature_notes.redirect_to_new_domain: A redirect ends at an unfamiliar domain.
feature_notes.new_third_party_origins: Count of third-party origins not present in the local baseline.
feature_notes.excessive_hostname_hyphens: A hostname uses an unusually high number of hyphens.
